text: Hi! Sorry, I've been running round all day, Dennis has double booked himself with the bouncy castle AGAIN. Anyway I'm trying to get the field sorted before the committee tonight and honestly I think the teas should be nearer the entrance because of the queue last year, it went right across the car park. Could you shift it? Thanks so much, you're a star.
Jan, can you ring the hire people about the gazebos and ask if they deliver Friday not Saturday? Also remind Pete about the float, he said he'd bring coins. Thx x

Whoever invented this costume sheet deserves a medal, last year it was a shoebox of receipts. Anyway. Mrs Patel has already sewn the ghost's cloak and it's black, not grey, so can the shroud be black. And the ghost needs to be joined up to it, I think I forgot.
Perfect, thank you, that's exactly what I wanted!

I don't know if this is the right way to show it, I'm not very good with computers, but could you put the three baking tables in a row across the middle? Or maybe a circle would be better. Actually leave it, I'll ask Margaret what she thinks. Thank you anyway dear.

Dear Sam, I hope you are well and that the move went smoothly. As promised, here is the plan for Saturday's garage sale, which I am drawing on the computer because Joan said it would save us arguing on the day. Firstly, the toys should go next to the books, as children and parents tend to wander in together. Secondly, I would like the cash box to be red so it is hard to miss. Thirdly, could the furniture be made a little smaller, since it will not all fit on the drive. Finally, please add a sign at the very top that says Garage Sale. With kind regards, Maureen
ok that looks about right to me, going to show Phil at lunch and see if he moans

So the vicar has just told me we've got eleven stalls and room for about eight, great. I need a quick picture for the meeting. Entrance at the bottom, then the tombola in the middle, a coconut shy to its right, teas and cakes both at the top, and a raffle table. Don't bother with colours, the committee will only argue about those.
I can't see who's got the apron. Lots of running about today, the fitting is at seven, hope Doris has the pins.

Honestly I'm only doing this because my husband won't stop saying we'll never fit it all on the drive. Can you make the clothes table huge, and the tools table small, and then put the cash box in the middle where I can keep an eye on it. And no I haven't forgotten the sign, it's coming.

Right everyone, costume list for the panto. Cinderella, Buttons, two Ugly Sisters and the Fairy Godmother, each with a circle. Then a square for each costume, Cinderella has rags and a ballgown, so two, Buttons has the red jacket. Link each person to their costume please. I'll sort the sisters' wigs after the break.

Hello! It's Barbara from the flower rota, Father Tom said you might be able to help with the bake sale plan. Four tables if possible: cakes, bread, cookies and a table for the tea urn with a cash box next to it. Cakes should be nearest the door because they go first. I'm so sorry if this is the wrong place to ask.

Good morning. Following our phone call, a few changes please. The raffle table should go beside the entrance, where people will see it as they come in. The cakes and the teas should be joined with a line, because the same ladies are running both. I would also like the tombola to be blue, red is Dennis's colour and he has caused enough trouble already. If you could also tell me how many stalls are on the plan, I will put it in the newsletter.
